integrity: A complete replayable 471-step unimodular transformation certificate and an independent prime-power local Smith computation corroborate the invariant factors; these are exact finite computations.
scientific_limitations: The invariant factors are for the fixed unique cubic girth-seven cage only. The known spanning-tree count is not new; unindexed prior Smith-form tables might cover the decomposition. The spectral cage paper was not accessible in full. The two exact checkers and operation certificate are included.
title: Critical group of the McGee \((3,7)\)-cage
